test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

My friend said, “I am going to travel to Europe next month”.

options.text: My friend said that he was going to travel to Europe the following month.
My friend said that he will travel to Europe next month.
My friend says that he is going to travel to Europe next month.
My friend had said that he would travel to Europe the following month.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in reported speech, so the verb tense needs to shift back.
 
• The pronoun also needs to be adjusted from** "I"** to **"he" **to reflect the change in perspective.
 
• The phrase** "next month"** needs to be changed to "the following month" to maintain the temporal reference.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**My friend said that he was going to travel to Europe the following month**.'

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) My friend said that he will travel to Europe next month: **This option maintains the present tense "will," which is not appropriate for reported speech.
 
• **Option 3) My friend says that he is going to travel to Europe next month:** This option keeps the verb in the present tense "says," which does not reflect the past tense nature of reported speech.
 
• **Option 4) My friend had said that he would travel to Europe the following month: **This option uses the past perfect tense "had said," which is not necessary for reported speech. Additionally, it changes "next month" to "the following month," which alters the original meaning.
